summary.text: Kristin Dassler-Alfheim is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 18, based in Appleton, elected to the Senate in 2024.
She is vice-chair of the Special Committee on State-Tribal Relations and also serves on the Committee on Insurance, Housing, Rural Issues and Forestry.

paragraphs.text: Dassler-Alfheim was born in Wausau, Wisconsin, on August 26, 1971, and is married with one child, three stepchildren and one grandchild.
She graduated from D. C. Everest High School in 1989 and earned Retirement Income Certified Professional designations from The American College in 2018.
The Legislature's page lists her as president and owner of Retirement Dynamix LLC and a former managing director of Futurity First Insurance Group.
She was elected to the Appleton Common Council in 2021 and 2023.

She is a past state president of the National Association of Insurance and Financial Advisors and a member of the Sporting Heritage Council, the Wisconsin Housing and Economic Development Authority and the Women's Council.
